profile.name: gpuStack
profile.description: GPU stack shape for GKE GPU node pools — how the driver is installed and which device plugin advertises nvidia.com/gpu. The driver is Google-supplied in both values; the GPU Operator installs no driver on COS. "gke-default" (the default) is the default-provisioned cluster: GKE's bundled driver install plus GKE's managed device plugin as the advertiser (opt-out label absent everywhere), with the operator's plugin disabled. "driver-installer" runs the GPU Operator's device plugin as the sole advertiser; its verified generation-time constraint is that every GPU node carries gke-no-default-nvidia-gpu-device-plugin=true (the only durable distinguishing signal — ADR-015 DD5). Google's standalone nvidia-driver-installer DaemonSet on pools created with gpu-driver-version=disabled is the documented operational prerequisite that supplies the driver under this value; its presence is not qualified at generation — driver presence is observed by the deployment-phase validation.
